verdict.summary: The documentation-only reconciliation is internally coherent and appropriately caveated as research-grade and externally unaudited under sq-qhy4. Its load-bearing resolutions match the cited frozen CRDT specification and shipped primitives: the frozen profile rejects COPY/MOVE/ADD, requires JCS canonical envelopes and current membership-epoch validation, while the E2EE crate uses a u64 Epoch, randomized sealing, and the stated history-policy tokens. The amendments clearly mark superseded clauses in all three source records, preserve a single CRDT authority, disclose the added ReplicaId linkability concern, and avoid claiming implementation or cryptographic proof. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected.
